title: Atomic capacity reservations with compare-and-swap
summary: Claim several units at once without overselling, and recompute the claim after a conflicting update.
triggers: weighted reservation against an atomic capacity limit
compare-and-swap loop for a shared numeric invariant
prompts: Let several threads reserve seats in batches without ever taking more than the available capacity.
Recompute a requested deduction if another thread reserves seats between your load and compare-and-swap.
invariant: A successful claim subtracts units from the same observed count it validated. Remaining capacity never underflows.
mantra: Check the count, CAS the claim, retry from the observed count.
pitfalls: A separate load and subtraction lets several callers pass the same capacity check.
On failure, compare_exchange_weak writes the observed value into available. Recheck the bound and recompute the desired count each time.
Relaxed ordering suffices for the count itself. Publishing other data to readers requires separate synchronization.
Contention can force repeated retries and leave one caller waiting much longer than the others.
